# RooFinder
> Exclusive canvassing zones for roofing sales teams. Pre-qualified homeowner leads, built-in CRM, door-knocking routes, mobile team app, and live tracking. $999 first month, $2,500/mo. One zone per contractor — available nationwide.

## What We Do
RooFinder gives roofing companies an exclusive zip code territory of pre-qualified homeowners — filtered by roof age, home value, and owner-occupied status. The platform includes organized routes, a full CRM, a mobile agent app, an owner dashboard, and a live team scoreboard. Zones are built and delivered within 48 hours of signup.

## Key Facts
- Price: $999 first month, then $2,500/month flat
- No contracts — cancel anytime
- One contractor per zip code — exclusive, never shared
- Zone delivered within 48 hours
- Works on any phone — no app download required
- Available for any zip code in the United States
- Phone: (919) 480-8884
